Runes of Restoration Magic provide fixture attribute bonuses for Restoration Magic.

*A Ritualist Rune of Minor Restoration Magic provides +1 Restoration Magic.
*A Ritualist Rune of Major Restoration Magic provides +2 Restoration Magic and -35 health.
*A Ritualist Rune of Superior Restoration Magic provides +3 Restoration Magic and -75 health.
